## HOW TO RUN THIS

1. Fill your Sheet ID + tab name in every Google Sheets node (search 'YOUR_SHEET_ID_HERE')
2. Fill your API keys in the HTTP Request nodes: Google Custom Search, OpenAI, Vapi (search 'YOUR_..._HERE')
3. Set 'Search Engine ID' and 'Vapi Assistant/Phone Number ID'
4. Click 'Start Run' to kick it off
5. Leave this browser tab + n8n running. It will keep looping through leads, one call at a time, with a real 15-min gap after each call ends, until no eligible leads remain.
6. To stop early: just cancel the execution from the n8n Executions tab.

SHEET COLUMNS REQUIRED (exact headers):
Business Name | Phone | City | State | Rating | Review Count | Website | Call Status | Last Called At | Follow Up Date | Outcome Summary | Transcript | Meeting Booked | Attempt Count

Call Status values this workflow writes: Booked / Not Interested / Follow-Up Requested / No Answer / Do Not Call / Call Timeout

CALLING HOURS: only dials a lead if it's currently 9AM-9PM in THAT LEAD'S OWN state/time zone (not yours, not one fixed US zone). If eligible leads exist but all are outside their calling window right now, the workflow pauses and rechecks every 30 minutes instead of stopping - so it self-resumes once someone's local morning arrives, no manual restart needed.

3 outputs from the Switch above:
- hasLead -> goes on to place the call
- waitingForHours -> eligible leads exist but it's outside 9AM-9PM in all of their local time zones right now; waits 30 min then rechecks (self-resumes, no restart needed)
- noneLeft -> nothing eligible at all; workflow ends, re-run 'Start Run' once new leads exist

This node's IF only checks status == 'ended'.
After import, edit it to also branch true when {{ $json.timed_out }} is true (OR condition), so a stuck call after ~10 minutes of polling doesn't loop forever - it'll fall through as 'Call Timeout' instead.
